thread:
Samir: Heads-up — Orbiton wants a 4-week POC for a customer-tuned model 'orbiton-compliance-10b'. They want an INT4 generation variant, embeddings, SAML SSO, and BYOK KMS. Their SLA ask: p95 < 260ms on 120-token queries at 20 qps bursts. Can SE/Infra/Legal confirm feasibility and blockers?
Noelle: Quick take: 10B->INT4 conversion is usually feasible but depends on fused ops and attention implementation. Request model artifacts: model.tar.gz, config.json, tokenizer.json, and a small validation set (~100 prompts). Tokenizer is critical for compliance models since they sometimes have custom redaction tokens.
Evan: Perf/infra: To hit p95<260ms at 20 qps bursts recommend Dedicated pool with baseline 2x A100-80GB and autoscale to 3 for peaks. INT4 helps but we'll validate conversion. For embeddings, route to a separate pool optimized for larger batches. Also recommend latency-first batching with max_wait_ms=6.
Ritika: Security/compliance: BYOK + SAML supported. Need DPA signed and confirmation they will not feed PHI during POC unless on Private. If customer requests hosted BYOK, we use KMS proxy and require key rotation policy confirmation. Also we need their data residency (US/EU) for log routing.
Jules: Commercial: I'll prepare two options — Quick Hosted Dedicated 30d POC pricing and Private deployment (setup + monthly). Ballpark for Dedicated baseline + BYOK ~ $30k/mo committed but will refine after token counts and perf.
Noelle: SE checklist I'll need: 1) tokenizer validation (Noelle) 2) conversion & sanity-run (Noelle/Evan) 3) perf sweep (Evan) 4) security sign-off (Ritika) 5) quote (Jules).
Samir: Can someone draft the autoscale + batching config we can send Orbiton? They prefer something they can sign off quickly.
Evan: Draft autoscale snippet to propose:
```
# autoscale proposal
min_nodes: 2
max_nodes: 3
target_util: 0.6
warm_pool: 1
cooldown_seconds: 60
# batching
latency_first: true
max_batch_tokens: 4096
max_batch_wait_ms: 6
```
Send that as-is for initial sign-off.
Ritika: Legal note: ask Orbiton to return SAML SP metadata and KMS key policy. Also request answers to our security questionnaire within 5 business days; otherwise we default to Private for POC.
Jules: I'll include two pricing lines and an optional line for extended log retention (30/90/365). Retention impacts cost and may force Private deployment for EU residency.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-5120 created for Orbiton POC, assigned to Noelle (ml-eng), Evan (infra), Ritika (security). Due 2026-04-20.
Noelle: I'll prepare the conversion plan and a quick accuracy sanity check (compare 100 seed prompts vs their baseline). Expect initial perf numbers within 48h after artifacts.
Samir: I'll send Orbiton the asset checklist: tokenizer.json, 100 samples, model weights/hash, SAML metadata, KMS ARN, and residency preference. Schedule tech sync next Tue.
Jules: One more ask from Orbiton: can we support vector similarity search with approximate nearest neighbors (ANN) in-host? Answer: yes, but we recommend separating embedding generation and ANN serving. Will include in the SOW.
Samir: Great, thanks team — aim to have a draft SOW and quote before the tech sync. :thumbsup:
